proof_body:
by
  have hder : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 7 / 7 - 2 * y ^ 6 / 3 + y ^ 5 - 4 * y ^ 3 / 3 + 4 * y - 4 * Real.arctan y)
      (x ^ 4 * (1 - x) ^ 4 / (1 + x ^ 2)) x := by
    intro x _
    have hd := (((((hasDerivAt_pow 7 x).div_const 7).sub (((hasDerivAt_pow 6 x).const_mul 2).div_const 3)).add (hasDerivAt_pow 5 x)).sub
      (((hasDerivAt_pow 3 x).const_mul 4).div_const 3)).add ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul 4) |>.sub ((Real.hasDerivAt_arctan x).const_mul 4)
    refine HasDerivAt.congr_deriv (f := fun y : ℝ => y ^ 7 / 7 - 2 * y ^ 6 / 3 + y ^ 5 - 4 * y ^ 3 / 3 + 4 * y - 4 * Real.arctan y) hd ?_
    have : (1 + x ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  have hc : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 4 * (1 - x) ^ 4 / (1 + x ^ 2)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
    apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
    apply Continuous.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
    intro x
    positivity
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hder hc]
  simp only [Real.arctan_one, Real.arctan_zero]
  norm_num
  ring
